Thomas has confirmed the subpoena scope covers exactly four distributors during calendar years 2019 through 2021, which defines our preservation and interview scope. And Jordan has confirmed the implicated VP has separate counsel and won't participate in a company interview without written consent from that counsel, which directly affects our interview plan as drafted.

I have no additional private facts to disclose. At this point, I believe we have enough on the formal record to finalize our submission. Maya's confirmation of the improper payment amount and finance's sign-off means we are obligated under our DOJ-response policy to include authorization of a voluntary disclosure in this initial response. I'd like to settle on the following terms: we authorize the voluntary disclosure at $275,000, scope the investigation to the four distributors and calendar years 2019–2021 as Thomas confirmed, and adjust our interview protocol to account for the VP's separate counsel. Does anyone object before I sign?
